proposed_comments.title: Reject chords whose second key is L

confidence.rationale: Shortcut::SetKeyCodes stores the trailing key of a true two-step chord in secondKey, while the current condition checks only actionKey. The fork fix and added regression cases pass all 92 editor tests.

proposed_comments.body:
### Reject chords whose second key is L

**Severity:** `high`

The broadened check still allows a true two-step chord such as `Win+K, L`, because the trailing `L` is stored in `secondKey` rather than `actionKey`. With Win still held for the chord, that final key can invoke the protected `Win+L` action and lock the PC. Check both action-key positions and add a matching regression case.

```suggestion
        if (shortcut.winKey != ModifierKey::Disabled && (shortcut.actionKey == 0x4C || shortcut.secondKey == 0x4C))
```

proposed_comments.title: Include the declaration for VK_WIN_BOTH

confidence.rationale: A clean targeted build of the upstream-equivalent test source fails because EditorHelpersTests.cpp uses CommonSharedConstants::VK_WIN_BOTH without including common/interop/shared_constants.h; adding that include makes the project compile and all 92 tests pass.

proposed_comments.body:
### Include the declaration for `VK_WIN_BOTH`

**Severity:** `high`

`EditorHelpersTests.cpp` now references `CommonSharedConstants::VK_WIN_BOTH`, but its include list does not provide that declaration, so `KeyboardManagerEditorTest.vcxproj` fails to compile. Please add `#include <common/interop/shared_constants.h>` alongside the other common interop headers.
